Well educated nurses will provide competent and quality nursing care for individuals, families and community. Nursing education is dynamic which is reviewed and develops constantly for meeting the learner’s needs. Mission The best possible education to prepare confident, competent and caring nurses and nursing leaders. The mission of College of Nursing is to provide Accessible, Affordable High Quality Education to diverse students for the development of nurse practitioners at all entries of practice. Goal Our aim is to impart nursing education of high standard so that the students passing out from this institute will be able to render quality nursing care to all the clients in the hospital, community and the various settings such as school, industry etc. with compassion and care. About Our College Bombay Nurses’ Training Institute was established in 1952 and upgraded to Bombay Hospital College of Nursing in the year 2004. The Bombay Hospital College of Nursing is a pioneering institution which promotes quality Nursing Education in the country.
